name: WinMain
description: srand(timeGetTime()), init, message loop calling the frame function every 33 ms (3 ms while DAT_0044d02c == 0)

name: frame
description: one frame: A-B-C key sequence for tool modes (F1-F3), then menus or match; key-sequence part ported as World::step

name: menus
description: main menu and top-level state (thiscall on 0x458b00); state 2 runs match_frame [menu_title (states -2, 0, 6, 7, 8), menu_main; network screens 1-4 via net_check.py]

name: match_frame
description: one match frame: data load on first call, input, F-keys, network, tick, random weapon drops, drawing; ported as World::match_frame/tick for VS mode

name: wndproc
description: window procedure; writes 'd'/'u' to the key array 0x455378 on key down/up, mouse to 0x4546f0/0x453cdc

name: read_inputs_and_ai
description: copy keys of players 1-4 into objects 0-7 (on half_frame 0), then AI for objects 10-399

name: read_remote_inputs
description: network/replay: key bytes into objects whose player slot is -1 [net_check.py (original against the port, both roles)]

name: ai_character
description: computer player AI for one character (calls 0x403a40, 0x408cb0, 0x4034f0)

name: ai_use_specials
description: character AI: per-character special-move decisions; returns 1 when it chose one [specials_<hero> traces]

name: ai_use_weapon
description: character AI while holding a weapon; returns 0 to end the AI call [ai_items, ai_<hero> traces]

name: ai_basic_attacks
description: character AI: attack, defend and dash attack near the target [ai_<hero> traces]

name: ai_projectile
description: steering for objects whose frame has hit_Fa > 0 (homing balls)

name: between
description: 1 when b lies strictly between a and c (either order)

name: abs_int
description: absolute value (used by AI and fusion)

name: obj_controls
description: key timers, special-move inputs, walking/running/jumping/dashing from keys

name: push_key
description: push a key code into the five-entry history at 0x408

name: other_key_pressed
description: whether a key other than the given one was pressed this tick

name: goto_frame
description: switch frame for hit_* inputs; pays hp/mp cost when specials cost mp

name: special_DJA
description: defend, jump, attack -> hit_ja (with the Louis/LouisEX rule) [specials traces]

name: obj_move
description: velocity, friction, gravity, landing and bouncing; truncate to ix/iy/iz

name: obj_update
description: apply registered hits: damage, knockback, falls, defend, catch, pick up, balls, sparks

name: obj_post_update
description: per-object timers, frame advance by wait/next, jump start, mp-cost frames

name: bound_and_carry
description: clamp characters to the background's z range; place held weapons; throw, drop, drink

name: catch_hold
description: put a caught object at the catcher cpoint, cpoint injury

name: collisions
description: itr/bdy tests between all object pairs, then after_collisions

name: itr_touches_bdy
description: bounding-box test of an attacker's itrs against a victim's bdys

name: register_hit
description: per itr/bdy test; adds the victim to the attacker's hit list

name: after_collisions
description: Firen + Freeze fusion into Firzen, and the split

name: apply_knockback
description: turn knockback collected this tick into velocity

name: bound_x_and_camera
description: clamp x, remove objects that leave the background, camera

name: draw_background
description: draws the background layers; ported in lf2-app render.rs (picture compared with the original)

name: draw_objects
description: z-sorted object drawing; advances hit-spark animations (ported as advance_sparks)

name: draw_object
description: draws one object; ported in lf2-app render.rs (picture compared with the original)

name: draw_hud
description: draws the eight status panels; ported in lf2-app render.rs (picture compared)

name: draw_mode_label
description: draws "VS mode (Difficult)" and similar [every match trace (0x450c38)]

name: draw_replay_info
description: draws replay information [draws into the draw list (replay.rs draw_replay_info)]

name: teleport
description: states 400/401: move next to the nearest enemy or farthest teammate

name: fill_random_table
description: 3000 bytes of rand() % 255 + 1; called when "game start" is clicked [menu_main (boot state), menu_title]

name: play_sound
description: queue a system sound with left/right volume from x

name: play_sound_id
description: queue a data-file sound with left/right volume from x

name: flush_sounds
description: play queued sounds at the end of a frame and clear the flags

name: load_wave
description: load a .wav into a DirectSound buffer (mmio)

name: play_buffer
description: play a DirectSound buffer directly (menu sounds)

name: play_music
description: play a bgm file unless it is already playing [menu_pick, menu_pick_stage (0x44ef04)]

name: draw_music_menu
description: music selection on the pick screen [menu_pick]

name: music_for_stage
description: bgm file for a stage [menu_pick_stage, demo]

name: dd_startup
description: DirectDraw cooperative level and display mode

name: dd_fake_flipper
description: create primary and back buffer for windowed mode

name: clear_surface
description: fill a surface with one colour (Blt with DDBLT_COLORFILL); frame() clears the back buffer to black with it every frame [lf2-app render.rs draw_frame]

name: dd_copy_bitmap
description: StretchBlt a GDI bitmap into a surface

name: create_window
description: register class and create the 794x550 window

name: surface_from_bitmap
description: create a DirectDraw surface from a bitmap with colour key

name: blit_sprite
description: blit one cell of a sprite sheet (lf2-app Frame::blit)

name: pump_messages
description: process waiting window messages during loading

name: load_object
description: object .dat loader (lf2-data object.rs; memory dump test)

name: load_all_data
description: data.txt loader (lf2-data lib.rs; memory dump test)

name: load_background
description: bg.dat loader (lf2-data bg.rs; memory dump test)

name: load_stages
description: stage.dat loader (lf2-data stage.rs; memory dump test)

name: decode_file
description: decode a .dat into a given file (lf2-data crypt.rs)

name: encode_file
description: encode a text file into .dat (lf2-data crypt.rs)

name: sound_lookup
description: find or add a sound name in the global table

name: obj_reset
description: clear an object for reuse (used by every spawn)

name: draw_loading_screen
description: Now Loading screen with the current file name

name: save_controls
description: write data\control.txt [menu/title.rs save_controls; the file text is not compared with the original's]

name: key_name
description: name of a virtual key for the controls dialog [menu_main]

name: key_char
description: character for a key (typing names, IP addresses) [menu_title]

name: game_menus
description: pick screen, dialogs and end-of-match screens for VS and Stage [menu_pick, menu_pick_com, menu_pick_stage, demo]

name: end_match
description: called when a match ends (stops recording) [match_end, champ1, champ2]

name: stage_mode_tick
description: stage mode per tick: phases, spawning soldiers and bosses [stage_1, stage_1_clear, menu_survival]

name: recording_start
description: allocate a recording and copy the RNG table into it [rec_messages, demos test]

name: recording_write_frame
description: write one frame of keys into the recording [demos test (recorded hp sums)]

name: replay_read_frame
description: read one frame of keys from a replay [demos test]

name: replay_restore
description: restore state after a replay [demos test]

name: replay_load
description: load a .lfr and restore the RNG table [demos test]

name: net_receive
description: accept/recv; receives the RNG table from the server [net_check.py]

name: fkey_f8
description: F6: specials cost no mp [weapon_rain, ai_items]

name: tool_alloc
description: allocation used by the data editor

name: tool_save_object
description: data editor: write an object back as text

name: draw_box
description: draw a frame picture by pic number (lf2-app draw_object)

name: draw_box2
description: cell width of a frame picture

name: static_init
description: static initialiser of the game object

name: dd_restore_surfaces
description: Restore the primary and back surfaces after they are lost

name: crt_cxx_exception_filter
description: CRT: terminate on an uncaught C++ exception

name: crt_set_fpu_precision
description: _controlfp_s(NULL, _PC_53, _MCW_PC): x87 at 53-bit precision. No other code changes the control word (checked: the only fldcw/fnstcw in .text is the read inside _ftol2)
